meta.description: Inbound WhatsApp → qualify (name, budget, locality, timeline, purpose, BHK) → Google Sheet → hot email. One client per workflow copy.

parameters.content:
## LeadSpark
**Step 1 of the product:** WhatsApp qualification only.

1. Fill **Client config** (pink)
2. Add credentials (WhatsApp, Gemini, Sheets, Gmail)
3. Paste Phone number ID on Send node
4. Paste Google Sheet ID on both Sheet nodes
5. Activate workflow
6. Meta → webhook = this Trigger **Production URL**
7. Subscribe to **messages** only

See `n8n/SETUP.md` in the repo.

## Hot / warm / cold
**Hot:** phone + budget fits listing (~80%) + timeline soon (week / month / immediate)
**Warm:** has phone or budget or name
**Cold:** browsing

Email fires **once** when score becomes hot.
